input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL), 0) > 0.1
  AND sat.NumGE1500 > 0
